name: Otowa Kaoru
source: Kaoru is a girl who transfers into [url=/c7877]Tomoya[/url]'s class near the beginning of the story. She maintains a cheerful personality and articulate social skills, and excels in language subjects, but she isn't as good at math. Her hobby is watching movies.
